nodes.description: Governance address with privileged control; initialized to msg.sender in constructor.
Strategist address authorized with governance for admin actions and receiving harvest fees.
Controller contract address authorized to trigger withdrawals.
Address of the want token (OHM) staked and withdrawn by the strategy.
Output token address, set to OHM in constructor.
Pool address state variable (declared, unused).
Total amount currently staked through the strategy; used to compute harvest rewards.
Farm contract address that receives harvested rewards.
Mapping of addresses authorized to call onlyBenevolent-gated functions.
Percentage of harvest paid to the strategist (default 20).
Percentage of harvest routed to the farm (default 70).
Withdrawal fee in basis points used in withdraw().
Constant fee denominator (10000) used for fee math.
Timestamp of the last harvest; compared against block.timestamp in harvest().
Constant address of the Olympus staking contract used for stake/unstake.
Constant OHM token address.
Constant sOHM token address used for balance accounting.
Constant gOHM token address (declared, unused).
Initializes governance to msg.sender, sets strategist, controller, want and out.
Adds an authorized farmer; restricted to governance or strategist.
Removes an authorized farmer; restricted to governance or strategist.
Updates governance address; restricted to current governance.
Updates strategist address; restricted to governance or strategist.
Updates withdrawal fee; restricted to governance.
Updates the sOHM farm address; restricted to governance.
Updates restake percentage; restricted to governance.
Returns the contract's want token balance.
Returns the contract's sOHM balance.
Unstakes sOHM rewards, splits fees between strategist and farm, and re-deposits; time-gated by lastHarvestTime.
Public wrapper that calls _deposit().
Fallback receive function accepting plain Ether.
Internal deposit that approves and stakes want tokens into OlympusStaking and updates totalStake.
Public helper unstaking a specified amount of sOHM and accounting the withdrawn want tokens.
Controller-only full withdrawal: unstakes everything and transfers to the controller vault.
Internal helper that unstakes the entire sOHM balance.
Controller-only withdrawal of a specific amount, applying the withdrawal fee and sending to the vault.
Controller-only rescue of stray non-want tokens held by the contract.
Caller address used throughout for authorization checks.
Block timestamp used in the harvest time gating check.
External call to IOlympusStaking.unstake in harvest() with attacker-influenced state.
Low-level address(token).call() inside SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn used for all token transfers.
Raw subtraction of totalStake from sOHM balance to compute rewards in harvest().
External call to FarmsOHM(sOHMfarm).set_initReward() whose return value is assigned to lastHarvestTime.
External call to IOlympusStaking.stake() in _deposit().
Token safeTransfer to the controller vault in withdraw(uint256).
External call to IOlympusStaking.unstake() for the full balance in _withdrawAll().
Constructor parameter _controller assigned to the controller state variable.
Farmer address parameter f of addFarmer.
Farmer address parameter f of removeFarmer.
New governance address parameter _governance.
New strategist address parameter _strategist.

New farm address parameter _sOHMfarm.
New restake percentage parameter _restake.
Amount parameter _amount of _withdrawSome.
Amount parameter _amount of withdraw(uint256).
Token parameter _asset of withdraw(IERC20).
Local rewards amount computed as sOHM balance minus totalStake in harvest().
Local strategist fee amount computed from OHM balance in harvest().
Local restake amount computed from OHM balance in harvest().
Local remaining OHM balance after subtracting fee and restake amounts in harvest().
Local _want amount read from want balance in _deposit().
Local _before want balance snapshot in _withdrawSome().
Local _after want balance snapshot in _withdrawSome().
Local _withdrew amount derived from _after minus _before in _withdrawSome().
Local wamount read from balanceOf() in _withdrawAll().
Local _balance want balance read in withdraw(uint256).
Local _fee computed from amount and withdrawalFee in withdraw(uint256).
Local _vault address retrieved from the controller and validated non-zero.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns governance = msg.sender.
addFarmer requires msg.sender to be governance or strategist.
removeFarmer requires msg.sender to be governance or strategist.
setGovernance requires msg.sender == governance.
setStrategist requires msg.sender to be governance or strategist.
setWithdrawalFee requires msg.sender == governance.
setsOHMfarm requires msg.sender == governance.
setReward requires msg.sender == governance.
harvest is gated by onlyBenevolent and the isContract(msg.sender) check.
withdrawAll requires msg.sender == controller.
withdraw(uint256) requires msg.sender == controller.
withdraw(IERC20) requires msg.sender == controller.
harvest compares block.timestamp with lastHarvestTime, a timestamp dependency.
lastHarvestTime is read and updated in the harvest time check.
totalStake is used to derive the rewards amount in harvest.
sOHMfarm receives the balance and provides the set_initReward return value.
strategistReward scales the strategist fee amount.
restake scales the restake amount in harvest.
sOHM balance is read to compute rewards and approve staking.
OHM balance is read to compute fee, restake and remaining amounts.
OlympusStaking is approved and called for unstaking in harvest.
want balance is read in _deposit to determine the stake amount.
OlympusStaking is approved and called for staking in _deposit.
totalStake is incremented by the deposited amount.
totalStake is decremented by the withdrawn amount in _withdrawSome.
sOHM is approved before unstaking in _withdrawSome.
OlympusStaking.unstake is invoked in _withdrawSome.
want balance and transfers are handled in withdraw(uint256).
controller is used to resolve rewards and vault addresses in withdraw.
controller is used to resolve the vault address in withdrawAll.
controller receives the rescued token balance.
withdrawalFee is applied to compute the withdrawal fee.
FEE_DENOMINATOR divides the fee computation in withdraw.
harvest calls _deposit at the end of its execution.
deposit delegates to _deposit.
withdrawAll calls _withdrawAll to unstake everything.
withdraw(uint256) calls _withdrawSome when the local balance is insufficient.
harvest performs the external OlympusStaking.unstake call.
harvest computes rewards via a raw balance subtraction of totalStake.
harvest makes an external FarmsOHM.set_initReward call on an arbitrary sOHMfarm address.
_deposit performs the external OlympusStaking.stake call.
_withdrawAll performs the external OlympusStaking.unstake call.
withdraw(uint256) transfers want tokens to the vault.
withdrawAll transfers the full want balance to the vault.
withdraw(IERC20) transfers tokens through SafeERC20 low-level call.
withdraw(uint256) executes token transfers through SafeERC20 low-level call.
harvest transfers tokens through SafeERC20 low-level calls.
_controller is assigned to the controller state variable.
f is validated and stored in the farmers mapping.
f is used to clear the farmers mapping entry.
_governance is validated and stored as governance.
_strategist is validated and stored as strategist.
_withdrawalFee is stored as the withdrawal fee.
_sOHMfarm is stored as the farm address.
_restake is stored as the restake percentage.
_amount is passed to IOlympusStaking.unstake.
_amount is used to compute the withdrawal and fee.
_asset is read for balance and transferred out.
rewards is computed in and used by harvest.
feeamount is computed and transferred in harvest.
restakeamount is computed and used in harvest.
balance is computed and sent to the farm in harvest.
_want is computed and staked in _deposit.
_before snapshots the want balance in _withdrawSome.
_after snapshots the want balance in _withdrawSome.
_withdrew is computed and reduces totalStake in _withdrawSome.
wamount is computed and unstaked in _withdrawAll.
_balance is read and compared with the requested amount in withdraw.
_fee is computed from withdrawalFee and transferred to controller rewards.
_vault is resolved from the controller and validated in withdrawAll.
